statement: SUID cases with prior child deaths are more likely to have reported sleep environment issues compared to those without prior child deaths.
rationale: The design uses a case-only approach to compare SUID cases based on whether they had previous child deaths, focusing on sleep environment and prenatal care issues. The ncfrp_v51 dataset provides detailed information on these factors for reviewed cases.
prior_art: None in the inputs; while there are studies on sleep environment and prenatal care issues, none specifically compare SUID cases based on prior child deaths.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causality or provide population-level estimates.
